title: One-step decision-tree depth bound under a random restriction
statement:
Fix an integer $n \ge 1$, let $w \ge 1$, and let $g_1, \dots, g_{s_2}$ be $s_2$ DNF formulas on $n$ Boolean variables, each of width at most $w$. Assume that in every term of every $g_i$ no literal is repeated and no two distinct literals share a variable. Let $p \in \bbr$ satisfy $0 < p \le \tfrac{1}{40w}$ (so in particular $p \le 1$). Then, under a Bernoulli($p$) random restriction $\rho$ on the $n$ variables, the probability that every restricted formula $x \mapsto g_i(\rho.\mathrm{extend}\,x)$ has decision-tree depth at most $\ell$ is at least
\[
  1 - s_2\left( \left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)^{\ell} + \exp\!\left(-np/3\right) \right).
\]
